definitions.explanation: A formal way to say 'this year.' Used in official documents, business correspondence, speeches, and formal greetings.

examples.japanese: {本年|ほんねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いいたします→お願いいたします：27603_onegaiitashimasu⟧。
examples.english: I look forward to your continued support this year.

examples.japanese: {本年度|ほんねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This fiscal year's budget was approved.

examples.japanese: {本年|ほんねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧50⟦{周年|しゅうねん}→周年：09520_shuunen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧すべき⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦でございます→でございます：19539_degozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: This year is a memorable year as we celebrate our 50th anniversary.

notes:
A formal equivalent of ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧ (this year). Used exclusively in formal writing and speech, such as business letters, official reports, New Year's greetings, and public announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本年|ほんねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いいたします→お願いいたします：27603_onegaiitashimasu⟧: standard New Year greeting in business
- {本年度|ほんねんど}: this fiscal/academic year
- {本年中|ほんねんちゅう}: during this year
- {本年|ほんねん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: as for this year (opening phrase in speeches)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧: this year — the standard, everyday word; used in all registers
- ⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧: last year — the formal equivalent of ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧
- ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧: next year — used in both formal and casual registers

REGISTER:
Highly formal. Using {本年|ほんねん} in casual conversation would sound stiff and unnatural. In everyday speech, always use ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧ instead.
